title: This Spider Walks on Water, Then Hides Underwater for 30 Minutes
subject: fishing spider

scenes.text: This spider can run on a pond. Then it vanishes under it, with no gills.
A fishing spider rests its front legs on the surface to feel the vibrations of prey.
It rows and runs across the water, and even sails when the wind catches it.
When a predator comes, it dives and swims, wrapped in a shiny layer of air held by water-repellent hairs.
That silver air layer lets it stay under for up to thirty minutes.
It even hunts the surface. A spider with a built-in diving tank.

description:
A fishing spider runs across a pond, then dives under it with no gills.
Water-repellent hairs hold a shiny layer of air around its body, letting it stay under for up to 30 minutes.
Would you swim with a spider like this? Comment below.
first_comment: Spider that walks on water or spider that dives for half an hour: which one is cooler?
